title: Muse Spark Open on DGX Spark: NVFP4 to Q2 requantization plus the seeded expert cache
purpose: Starting from stock llama.cpp and the official Muse Spark Open NVFP4 checkpoint, how much do time to first token, decode rate and total request time change when the routed experts are requantized to Q2_K, and again when the profile-seeded expert cache is added?

covers: client time to first token, decode tokens per second and total request time at 512 and 2048 rendered prompt tokens, cold and warm
the NVFP4 GGUF pack built from the official checkpoint, and a Q2_K requantization of it
greedy output parity with the cache gate unset, and the activation marker with it set
excludes: accuracy benchmarks; Q2 quality is a sanity check, not a claim
hardware other than one DGX Spark

model.name: Muse Spark Open 816B-A42B, official NVFP4 checkpoint (unsloth/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-NVFP4)
model.digest_status: Shard digests are pinned by node pin_inputs; the GGUF packs are named by the manifests their nodes publish.

prompt_512.description: Fixed text that renders to 512 tokens with the Muse no-thinking chat template.

prompt_2048.description: Fixed text that renders to 2048 tokens with the Muse no-thinking chat template.

calibration_prompts.description: Calibration requests for the routing profile; disjoint from the lab prompts.

arms.summary: Base engine E0 (stock plus expert scale wiring) on the NVFP4 pack.
deviations: Expert scale wiring, needed for stock to run the official NVFP4 weights correctly

arms.summary: E0 on the Q2_K requantized pack: the quantization change alone.
deviations: Routed experts Q2_K instead of NVFP4

arms.summary: E1 (E0 plus the seeded expert cache) on the Q2_K pack with the Muse routing profile.
deviations: Routed experts Q2_K instead of NVFP4

client_ttft_ms.how: Client clock from sending the request to the first streamed token.

decode_tokens_per_second.how: Generated tokens after the first, over the time they took, from the server's timings.

request_total_ms.how: Client clock from sending the request to the last streamed token (128 generated tokens).

prompt_tokens_per_second.how: Prompt tokens over prompt processing time, from the server's timings.

sampled_peak_memory_bytes.how: Highest sampled resident memory of the engine process group under the cap.

load_seconds.how: From engine start to the health endpoint answering ready.

protocol.notes: Each arm is measured cold (pack pages evicted with posix_fadvise DONTNEED before the request) and warm (after 3 discarded warmups), reported separately. Arms rotate A,B,C,C,B,A.

checks.does: The server's prompt token count equals the request's rendered prompt token count.
On E1 with the cache gate unset, greedy output of each request equals arm B byte for byte.
With the cache gate set, the engine prints expert_weight_cache: active.
E0 on a pack without expert .scale tensors gives the same greedy output as stock.
An expert matmul and a layer slice of the NVFP4 pack match a torch dequantization of the checkpoint within tolerance.
Every routed expert weight of the NVFP4 pack is NVFP4 with its .scale tensor.
Every routed expert weight of the Q2 pack is Q2_K; other tensors keep their NVFP4-pack type.
One cold request under the memory cap returns coherent text.

rules: A timed cell counts only when the machine is quiet: load below 1.0 and no builds running.
B and C differ from A in their weights, so their outputs are not expected to match A; correctness for B and C is the pack census, coherent text and, for C, parity with B when the gate is unset.
Speed is reported as change against A, per prompt size, cold and warm separately.
Failures and no-gain results are reported, not dropped.

execution.notes: Every model load runs under a 96 GiB cgroup cap with no swap, one heavy job at a time.

notes: Task graph written by hand as the demo starting point (no intake).
The seeded expert cache is the earlier change measured on DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (engine.build_expert_weight_cache).

nodes.objective: Pin the stock llama.cpp tree, the official Muse NVFP4 checkpoint, the imatrix and the prompts by digest, and record the disk grant and memory cap.

outputs.name: pins
criteria: Names the stock commit 9048bad8 and the sha256 of every checkpoint shard, the index, the imatrix and each prompt.
Records free disk at least 1.4 TB, the cgroup memory cap and the available memory before any load.
Records the checkpoint scale-plane layout per tensor role: packed weight, block scale, global scale_2, input scale.

nodes.objective: Extend the stock converter so it reads the stacked Muse NVFP4 experts and their scale planes, then write the NVFP4 GGUF pack.

outputs.name: converter
criteria: Splits experts.gate_up_proj into gate and up halves in the source order (gate first) and keeps NVFP4 blocks bit-for-bit (no dequantize and requantize).
Writes one [n_expert] .scale tensor per routed expert weight from weight_scale_2; gate and up share their source scale.
Leaves the BF16 modules the checkpoint excludes (layers 0 and 61, self attention, lm_head) at their source type.
Times one expert before the full conversion and prints the projected total.
Touches only the files its capsule source map allows.

outputs.name: nvfp4_pack
criteria: Every routed expert weight in layers 1 to 60 is NVFP4 (ggml type 40) with a matching [n_expert] F32 .scale tensor.
The pack manifest lists per-file sha256, tensor census by type and total bytes.

nodes.objective: Apply the per-expert NVFP4 scale tensors in the Muse graph so the NVFP4 pack computes the same values as the checkpoint.

outputs.name: change
criteria: Passes the loaded ffn_gate_exps, ffn_up_exps and ffn_down_exps .scale tensors to the Muse mixture-of-experts block.
A pack without .scale tensors (the IQ2_XXS pack) gives byte-identical greedy output to stock.
One expert matmul and one layer slice of the NVFP4 pack match a torch dequantization of the checkpoint within the numerics tolerance.
Touches only the files its capsule source map allows.
With its switch unset (or the tensors it reads absent), the engine behaves exactly like stock: no new work, no changed output.
Errors and limits fall back to stock behaviour instead of crashing.

nodes.objective: Build the base engine E0 (stock plus scale wiring) and run one cold, capped NVFP4 inference.

outputs.name: base_engine
criteria: A source bundle of E0 against stock 9048bad8 with the sm_121 lab recipe, plus its build receipt.

outputs.name: smoke
criteria: One cold NVFP4 request under the 96 GiB cap returns coherent text; peak memory and available memory are recorded.

nodes.objective: Write a precision recipe and requantize the NVFP4 pack to a 2-bit pack: routed experts to Q2_K, everything else kept at its source type.

outputs.name: recipe
criteria: Names the source pack digest, the target type per tensor role and the imatrix digest; every chosen type has a GB10 kernel.

outputs.name: q2_pack
criteria: Every routed expert weight is Q2_K; attention, norms, router, embeddings and output keep their NVFP4-pack type; .scale tensors carried unchanged.
Total size between 250 and 320 GB; the temporary disk peak stayed inside the grant.
Eight held-out prompts give coherent text; top-1 token agreement with the NVFP4 pack is reported, not claimed.

nodes.objective: Record which experts the Q2 pack routes to on calibration prompts that do not overlap the lab prompts.

outputs.name: profile
criteria: Per layer and expert hit counts for prompt and decode phases, from the event recorder, with the prompt set digest.
The calibration prompts share no request with the lab workload.

nodes.objective: Port the profile-seeded expert weight cache (the earlier time-to-first-token change) onto E0 for the Muse layer and expert shapes, off by default.

outputs.name: change
criteria: Implements the seeded native expert cache as the capsule method describes, on top of the E0 change.
With LLAMA_EXPERT_CACHE_NATIVE_PROFILE unset, greedy output is byte-identical to E0.
With it set and the Muse profile given, prints expert_weight_cache: active and seeded hits greater than zero.
Touches only the files its capsule source map allows.
Errors and limits fall back to stock behaviour instead of crashing.

nodes.objective: Build candidate engine E1 (E0 plus the seeded cache) and package the three lab arms.

outputs.name: sources
criteria: Source bundles for E0 and E1 against stock 9048bad8 with the sm_121 lab recipe.

outputs.name: smoke
criteria: One cold Q2 request on E1 under the cap returns coherent text with the activation marker.

nodes.objective: Send E0, E1, both packs, the profile and the lab task for arms A, B and C to the lab manager.

outputs.name: lab_request
criteria: The lab task fills arms A, B and C with shipped subjects and runs every check and metric, cold and warm, at 512 and 2048 tokens.
